name: develop
description: Single- and multi-issue engineering orchestration, implementation, integration, validation, repair, and merge handoff workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build and ship dev-ready issues and dependency chains.
interface.longDescription: An engineering-development family for single issues and multi-issue dependency graphs. Its lifecycle entrypoints require Product's Issue Router, then provide controller-owned waves, agent routing, technical design, implementation, cross-PR integration, validation, repair, PR creation, and merge handoff workflows.
defaultPrompt: Deliver this dev-ready issue through validation and merge handoff.
Execute this multi-issue dependency chain in safe ordered or parallel waves.
Integrate this explicit PR set in the supplied order.
Diagnose and repair this implementation or CI failure.
